note: *para o lugar santo*, singular, held against the Latinist (minor, then major) under D10: *os lugares santos* names the Holy Land sites in Brazil. MS1932's *para o santuário* merges *sancta* with *sanctuárium*.
*Durante as noites* (the stylist's, and MS1932's) for *Nas noites*, heard as unfinished; +4 syllables in a verse said every night at Compline. *De noite* loses the plural.

D11: *O Senhor te bendiga* keeps the psalm's one verb (*bendizei … te bendiga*); every Brazilian text and MS1932 turn to *te abençoe*. The blind reader understood it; the stylist named it the best line.
